run_sft_training: run supervised fine-tuning on a causal language model using SFTTrainer with a HuggingFace dataset
load_model_quantized: load a causal language model with Mxfp4 quantization and custom attention implementation
train_model_with_dataset: train a transformer model on a split dataset using SFTTrainer with packing and gradient checkpointing
save_and_push_model: save a trained model to disk and optionally push it to the HuggingFace model hub
parse_cli_training_args: parse CLI arguments and config files for model, training, and script settings using TrlParser
